WITH client_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    client.district_id,
    COUNT(*) as num_clients
  FROM client
  GROUP BY client.district_id
),
districts_with_clients AS (
  SELECT 
    cc.num_clients,
    d.A3 as region
  FROM client_counts cc
  JOIN district d ON cc.district_id = d.district_id
)
SELECT
  region,
  AVG(num_clients) as avg_per_district_count,
  AVG(CAST(num_clients AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client)) as avg_share
FROM districts_with_clients
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region
